adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the handler updates attendees via `prisma.booking.update(... include: { attendees: true })` into `bookingAttendees`, then constructs `evt.attendees` from `bookingAttendees.attendees`. However, it still calls `eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking)` using the earlier `booking` fetched by `findFirst` (pre-update). The diff confirms this mismatch of potentially-stale `booking` vs refreshed `evt`/`bookingAttendees`. Whether this becomes an actual bug depends on `updateCalendarAttendees`’ internal implementation (not shown in the diff), so the report’s claimed broken behavior can’t be strictly verified from the diff alone, but the concern is concrete and actionable (pass `bookingAttendees` or re-fetch).
